diagnosis.primary: 25 fractured tooth (K02.400) treatment plan: I5 extraction and implantation three months later

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol (3 tubes). After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
